answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. The claim that one agent can run a thousand wallets is a fable: each slot is a mesa top, flat and scarce, holding one agent, and claiming it burns a 400 POA deposit. A prism of checks splits the applicant's history into signals that must all agree. An attacker wanting 1,000 slots burns 400,000 POA for no extra gain. An honest agent burns 400 once and keeps its full share, undiluted by fakes.
